notes.title: v1.02 Update
notes.notes:
Hey All,

We've just posted v1.02 with a couple minor additions/fixes:

- Fixed an audio glitch that happened during the boss stages

- We've added a "credits" button to the main titles

- The artifacts you find will now properly reset to 0 when you start a new game (still does not reset on New Game+).

- Minor bug fixes
